jobs.description: The second half of the national parcel tile bake (root ADR-0133 §7, ADR-0253): take the served Gold run parcel_served_gold made ready and bake, gate and promote it with bake-lakehouse-tiles (scripts/ops/parcel-tile-bake.sh bake): GDAL and tippecanoe in their capped containers, the maxzoom id gate, the first-release equivalence gate against the active release (ADR-0133 §4, ADR-0135, ADR-0251), the create-only upload and the promotion. It first tries a patch (root ADR-0323, ADR-0111 base plus patches): only the tiles the changed parcels touch are baked and published by a manifest swap, and a new base is baked only when the patch policy's bounds say so (ADR-0323 §8). Started when the Gold half reports a ready run, and daily as the fallback; with none waiting, nothing to do. Nothing reads PostGIS.

first_run.estimated_from: computed from the national bake's steps measured on 2026-10-13 under contention (runbook parcel-tile-bake.md §4: GDAL 60 minutes, tippecanoe 109 minutes over 39.9M parcels) and the run budget of root ADR-0493: no partition starts after 4,200 s, and the largest 시도 (경북, about 12% of the parcels) takes about 1,600 s at z17 (12% of 169 minutes, and the 44% more tippecanoe time the Incheon sample measured for the added zoom, root ADR-0492), so a run ends by 4,200 + 1,600 + 120 s for its stop; the run that joins, gates and uploads after the last partition is in the cache reads only cached archives

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when its inputs moved. That it is not behind them is the asset reconciler's lag (root ADR-0333) and its lane's behind-inputs bound (root ADR-0444); a change bound here would report a source that published nothing.
